place.name: Church of Saint Francis of Assisi, Pampulha
place.description: The Church of Saint Francis of Assisi (Portuguese: Igreja de Sao Francisco de Assis, and commonly known as the Igreja da Pampulha) is a chapel in Pampulha region of Belo Horizonte, in the state of Minas Gerais, southeastern Brazil. It was designed by the Brazilian architect Oscar Niemeyer in the organic modern style.
